high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from Shikhar Dhawan (@SDhawan25) on Twitter. The tweet reads: "History! Congratulations to our hockey team on creating history! An outstanding achievement that won't be forgotten 🇮🇳👏" The tweet was posted at 9:39 AM on August 5, 2021, using the Twitter Web App. It has received 831 retweets, 10 quote tweets, and 18.5K likes. The tweet includes an image of a group of hockey players celebrating on the field. They are wearing blue uniforms
